newsitem.title: FINLAND: ENSO DECLINES TO COMMENT ON KNP LEYKAM.
newsitem.headline: ENSO DECLINES TO COMMENT ON KNP LEYKAM.

text.p: Finland's largest forest industry group Enso Oy on Monday declined to comment on its possible interest in teaming up with paper producer KNP Leykam.
"As a large fine paper producer we have naturally been mentioned," Enso's chief executive Jukka Harmala told reporters, but he did not say whether Enso had been engaged in talks.
"There is nothing concrete about these things at the moment," he said.
KNP Leykam's parent company KNP BT previously said it was seeking a partner for its ailing paper unit.
Enso's Harmala said he expects the world's forest industry is poised for more restructuring this decade.
"The only certain thing is that before the end of the decade there will still be significant structural rearrangement within our sector, in Europe and certainly elsewhere too," he said.
He did not specify what arrangements he expected or what role Enso could play but said there were many small units in Europe, particularly fine paper producers.
